features.quote: runs for a fixed number of turns, e.g. 40, unless it successfully solves the task

Continue until 40 turns. If the agent gives a stable blocker report, ask one standardized continuation prompt. If after that it repeats a stable blocker report, terminate as: termination_reason = stable_blocker_report
This avoids artificially forcing endless repetition while still measuring response to blockage.
features.justification_quote: This avoids artificially forcing endless repetition while still measuring response to blockage.
